name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.210
notes: Fixed: Secure Access Settings showed Not enabled after a successful save (or after keys were lost while the profile mirror still existed). Settings now restores from the profile mirror before computing Active/Not enabled.
Fixed: Main Save Settings no longer aborts the entire settings form when Secure Access fields are left blank. Incomplete Secure Access only blocks the dedicated Save Combination button.

Fixed: Save Combination now normalizes letter (uppercase) and symbol (lowercase), always writes CL_SEC_PROFILE_V1 and settings.securityProfile, and reopens Settings so the Active badge appears immediately.
Strengthened profile persistence so individual keys and the mirror stay in sync whenever Secure Access is saved.
label: SecureAccessPersistAndStatusFix
summary: Secure Access: restore-before-status, non-blocking Save Settings, normalized save with profile mirror, immediate Active badge after Save Combination.
fixes: Settings > Secure Access: status restores from CL_SEC_PROFILE_V1 / settings.securityProfile before showing Not enabled.
Settings > Save Settings: incomplete Secure Access fields no longer block saving other settings.
Settings > Save Combination: normalizes values, writes profile mirror, refreshes Settings to show Active.
testing: Open Settings > Secure Access, pick letter + symbol + question + answer, tap Save Combination. Expect success message, Settings reopens with Active, lock pill visible.
Close and reopen Settings: still Active.
Reload page: still Active; lock still works with the same combination.
Change other settings and tap Save Settings without touching Secure Access: other settings save; Secure Access stays Active.
